$comment: The five LEAD_* values from communication.model.ts:52-56. All five were enum members with a priority declared at :318-322 — and not one of them had a case in the 17-branch handler, so every LEAD_* event a caller sent was logged as unknown and dropped. Here they are playbooks, and an unmatched event is recorded as UNMATCHED rather than reported as a failure (D56).
$comment.aliases: The medspa pack needs aliases because its enum and its switch disagree about eight spellings (D56). Nothing has ever successfully sent a LEAD_* event, so there is no legacy spelling to be compatible with — the shorter names below are for callers who find the enum shouting unpleasant, not for anyone's existing integration.
